title: Grateful Dead Live at Pauley Pavilion on 1980-06-29
lineage: 1st gen copy w/ TC-D5M no n.r.  line-out -> Sound Devices 722 @ 24bit 48khz by mfrench (track split by Sound Studios 2.2.4, with some "dead-air" removed at tape flip points, with no other edits)
source: Senn MD421 n.c. -> Sony TC-D5 w/ Maxell XLII 90 - Master Maxell XLII cassette - TC-D5 ->  Teac A100 casette deck (first gen by mfrench)

ai_review.summary: Harsh, low‑level audience recording obscures the unusual Estimated‑Scarlet transition and unique Harmonica drums.
ai_review.review: The reviewer found the recording harsh with low volume and a loud audience, making it difficult to enjoy the show. They noted an unusual Estimated Prophet → Scarlet Begonias transition and a unique Harmonica drums segment, but the poor sound quality prevents any clear assessment of the performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief review with a low (2‑star) rating; recording issues dominate and there is insufficient detail on musical performance to raise the score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Harsh sound, low levels, audience noise loud; overall listening experience suffers.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewer mentions an unusual Estimated‑Prophet → Scarlet Begonias transition and a unique Harmonica drums segment, but cannot evaluate the set due to recording problems.
